card.name: Punctuation after year in citations
card.fires_on: The semicolon or colon right after a publication year in a journal reference, such as 'N Engl J Med 1982;'. It also fires weakly on 'selected' or 'managed' in clinical advice.

modes.label: Citation separator
modes.description: A semicolon or colon after the year in a journal citation, before the volume and page numbers.

modes.label: Care and selection verbs
modes.description: Words like selected or managed in advice about choosing or handling patients.
